verdict.line: You win the trades and solo kills through the first all-in window thanks to range, but if Nasus free-farms his stacks past that, the overall matchup is a flat 49.8% coin-flip over 1894 games.

brief.thesis: This is a tempo race: your E (Death's Grasp, 700 range) into Q (Obliterate, 675 range) combo outranges Nasus's 255-range Q (Siphoning Strike), which is exactly why Mordekaiser holds the lane and solo-kill advantage. But Nasus's Q permanently grows stronger every time it kills a unit, and his passive (Soul Eater) lifesteal plus eventual R (Fury of the Sands) let him convert uncontested farm into a flat-stat threat that erases your early lead - which is why the measured head-to-head sits dead even.

theirWindow.when: Once he has W (Wither), around level 4-6
theirWindow.what: Wither (700 range, cooldown 15/14/13/12/11s) decelerates your Movement and Attack Speed over time, which directly undoes your sustained auto-trading advantage. Don't commit to a long stand-and-trade once he has it off cooldown - burst and disengage instead.

yourWindow.when: Before he hits level 6 and before Wither is up
yourWindow.what: Land E (pulls all enemies in the area) into Q (damage to each enemy struck, increased on a single target) before he can get his melee-range Q off; finish with an auto to hit 3 landed hits and trigger your passive's damage aura and Move Speed.

start.item: Doran's Ring > Health Potion > Health Potion
start.why: Mana sustain and early magic damage for trading at range with E and Q; 51.1% win rate over 2076 games, 84.3% pick.

boots.why: Cuts down the autos and Wither-enabled extended trades Nasus leans on once lane goes long; 50.6% win rate over 1324 games, 56.5% pick.

core.why: The slow from your Q/E lets you actually land both hits of the all-in combo and keep him inside Death's Grasp range.
Omnivamp sustains you through extended trades and amplifies the damage your passive aura is already applying.
Burn damage punishes a Nasus who stands and trades in his own Spirit Fire; this path measures 59.1% win rate over 171 games.

situational.when: he builds into heavy attack speed or lifesteal for extended 1v1s
you need early grievous wounds to cut his Soul Eater lifesteal before he scales
you're leaning on W's shield-to-heal and need more healing power to win the sustain war

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks across your E+Q extended trades and converts to healing, reinforcing the sustained-damage trade you already win early; the Conqueror/Sorcery page measures 55.5% win rate in this matchup.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport posts the best measured win rate here (51.8%, 10.2% pick) and lets you reset waves safely while Nasus free-farms; Flash+Ignite (50.6%, 83.2% pick) is the more common pick if you want to convert your early solo-kill advantage into an actual kill.

playing.title: Open with E then Q
playing.detail: Death's Grasp (700 range) pulls Nasus before his 255-range Q can reach you, then Obliterate (675 range) hits for increased damage since it's a single target. This is your highest-value trade all lane.

playing.title: Finish every all-in with an auto
playing.detail: Darkness Rise triggers after 3 landed attacks or spells on a champion; your E into Q already counts for 2, so one auto locks in the damage aura and Move Speed before he can walk away.

playing.title: Track his Q cooldown, not just his HP
playing.detail: Siphoning Strike (255 range, cooldown 8/7/6/5/4s) is only a threat in melee range. Step up to deny last hits when it's down and back off right before it's back up.

playing.title: Don't out-trade a Withered Morde
playing.detail: Once he has W, it decelerates your Movement and Attack Speed over time - it directly removes the sustained-trading edge you have early. Burst and reset instead of standing in it.

playing.title: Save W's shield for the engage
playing.detail: Indestructible stores damage dealt and taken into a shield you can consume to heal. Pop it mid-combo during your E/Q all-in, not passively while poking, since the all-in is the trade you're favored to win.

playing.title: Stop free-farming past level 10
playing.detail: Siphoning Strike permanently gets stronger on every kill with no cap, so an uncontested Nasus at 20+ minutes hits far above his level. Deny minions in lane and through jungle pressure rather than letting him stack in peace.

playing.title: Use R to reset a fed Nasus
playing.detail: Realm of Death drags him into another dimension and steals a portion of his stats for the fight. This is your answer to a stacked Nasus 1v1 - it strips the exact stat lead that's letting him out-scale you.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the tactical reading - why the E/Q combo works, when Wither flips the trade, when to use R to reset a stacked Nasus - is my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Use [P] to gain the upper hand in prolonged fights and gain lane control. Purchase Bramble Vest and other items that increase armor.
